singular_truth: A text-only agent is blind to video. claude-video hands Claude the actual pixels: it pulls real frames plus a timestamped transcript from any link, so Claude answers from what it SAW at a given second, not from the title or metadata.
money_thing: The frame mosaic. A video collapses into a grid of extracted keyframes, near-duplicates dropped, and Claude reads them to answer a question about one specific moment.
logline: Watch a blind agent get eyes: one skill turns a video link into frames and a timestamped transcript, and Claude answers from what it actually saw.
rejected_default: The obvious treatment for an agent-tooling repo is wordmark open -> node diagram of the pipeline -> terminal typing a command -> flash -> wordmark close. Rejected: it is exactly the recipe the last 5 videos ran (node_diagram 5/6). This project's singular truth is VISUAL (frames), so the money device must be a frame mosaic (montage), not a boxes-and-arrows diagram. The pipeline still appears, but as a diegetic 3-pane status beat, not the hero.
references: contact-sheet / film-strip photography (a mosaic of frames)
a violet AI-perception console as the world color

self_critique.recognizably_ours: yes -- kinetic type, a terminal beat, a growth receipt and the brand grammar are all intact; only the SHAPE moved.
self_critique.shows_the_one_cool_thing: yes -- the frame mosaic (money_thing) is scene 3 and the grounded answer it enables is the money shot (scene 5).
self_critique.reads_as_a_different_production: yes -- montage + screen_capture + a violet perception world is nothing like the last 3 (node-diagram / split-compare on warm-orange and cyan-blue). Devices, open, close, palette and grammar all differ.
